_doc: shell-injection-argv-lint escapes (SD-LEO-INFRA-PUBLISH-SHELL-INJECTION-001-B). Keys are '<repo-relative-file>:<line>' or bare '<file>'; every value is a NON-EMPTY reason string — loadAllowlist throws otherwise (ledger, never a silent bypass). Prefer the inline pragma shell-injection-argv-disable-line for single reviewed lines.
